provenance: Authored documented-domain acceptance setups; no original or candidate execution. All exact-build applicability U.
units: Beat positions use quarter-note beats, note durations such as 1/8 are musical note values; half-open ranges describe authored fixture spans only, not a claimed target boundary rule.

cases.setup_action: In a fresh MIDI track, double-click an empty Session slot, then separately invoke Insert Empty MIDI Clip(s) on an Arrangement timespan [0,4).
cases.expected: A MIDI clip exists at each chosen location; initial length/defaults ungraded.

cases.setup_action: With Draw Mode on and pitch-lock on, drag across pitches; repeat holding Alt (Windows)/Option (macOS). Click an existing note. Turn Draw Mode off and double-click empty then occupied space.
cases.expected: First gesture remains on one pitch; modifier permits melodic drawing; occupied note is removed; inactive-mode double clicks add then remove.

cases.setup_action: Select notes A and B, Shift-click B, invert selection, then Escape. Separately select a time range containing A and press Enter.
cases.expected: B removed before inversion; complement selected after inversion; Escape leaves no notes selected; Enter toggles range/note selection.

cases.setup_action: Fixture A pitches 60,64 and 72; enable Pitch filter C, then Invert; click editor.
cases.expected: Pitches 60 and 72 selected, then 64 selected, then none; no filtering latency asserted.

cases.setup_action: With grid on, drag a note past several grid lines; repeat with Alt (Windows)/Cmd (macOS). Disable grid and repeat with that modifier.
cases.expected: Unmodified grid-on motion snaps after first encounter; modifier bypasses; modifier with grid off temporarily enables snapping. Pixel thresholds ungraded.

cases.setup_action: Same pitch: old [0,2), new [1,3); separately old [0,2), new [-1,1). Paste a copied note at beat 4.
cases.expected: First old note shortened at new start; second old note overwritten; pasted material starts at insert marker 4. Boundary-touch-only case ungraded.

cases.setup_action: Select two unequal notes, choose a quarter-note Duration and Set Length; deselect and choose eighth-note duration and Set Length.
cases.expected: Selected notes become one beat long, then all clip notes become half a beat long; no acceptance claim for malformed duration.

cases.setup_action: Select notes at beats 0 and 2 with time selection [0,4), stretch right marker to 8 with snapping disabled; separately cross markers. Include linked and unlinked envelopes.
cases.expected: First operation scales note times/lengths proportionally by two; crossing reverses order; linked timing follows, unlinked timing unchanged. Exact expression samples ungraded.

cases.setup_action: Deactivate note A, reactivate it; move imported-file note A then Undo; compare source MIDI file hash before/after.
cases.expected: Active status toggles; clip edit is reversible; original MIDI file digest unchanged. Playback timing/audio ungraded.

cases.setup_action: Note [0,2): split at 1; then join both same-pitch parts. At an insert marker outside all notes with no note selection inspect Split availability.
cases.expected: Two parts after split; one note after join; Split command unavailable in the stated no-intersection setup.

cases.setup_action: Clip scale C major; selected C-sharp at MIDI 61; Fit to Scale. Turn scale off and inspect Fit to Scale.
cases.expected: Note becomes C (60), lower of equidistant C/D; button unavailable without scale. Pitch-limit handling U.

cases.setup_action: One-beat grid; Humanize at maximum on selected note at beat 2. In separate fixture use Stretch factor 2 on quarter note with loop [0,4).
cases.expected: Humanized start remains in [1.75,2.25]; stretched duration becomes 2 beats; loop length stays 4. No random sample sequence asserted.

cases.setup_action: Two pitches at beat 0, select only A, draw velocity 40 in their grid cell; type 80 and Enter for A marker.
cases.expected: A changes to 40 then 80; unselected B unchanged.

cases.setup_action: Set note velocity 60 and deviation +20; inspect range, then double-click marker. Set randomization amount 0 and apply.
cases.expected: Deviation range 60..80, then zero; zero randomization amount permits no velocity offset. Playback RNG not tested.

cases.setup_action: No selection: set randomize amount 25 on notes at Chance 50; inspect before pressing Randomize, then apply.
cases.expected: Before application Chance stays 50; after application each value lies in 25..75. No distribution asserted.

cases.setup_action: Create group from simultaneous A/B with Play All, change to Play One, then ungroup B.
cases.expected: One diamond then triangle marker; B becomes individual after ungroup. Distribution and cross-time grouping ungraded.

cases.setup_action: Clip C major contains C and F-sharp; enable Fold to Scale, then Fold to Notes.
cases.expected: F-sharp row remains visible despite being out of scale; Fold to Notes shows used C/F-sharp rows; notes retained.

cases.setup_action: Loop [0,4), notes fully inside and fully outside; Crop Clip. Separately Insert Time using [1,2) with later note at beat 3.
cases.expected: Outside note removed without creating disk file; Insert Time moves later note to beat 4 while clip/loop bounds stay unchanged. Spanning-note cases ungraded.

cases.setup_action: Loop [0,4), note at beat 1 and outside note at 5; select brace and Duplicate.
cases.expected: Loop becomes length 8, copy at beat 5, original outside note moves to 9; distinguish note identity in comparison.

cases.setup_action: Two clips A/B; focus A, select/move A notes; attempt cross-clip selection. Disable Focus, select notes across A/B; edit velocity in foreground A lane.
cases.expected: Focus confines edits to A; nonfocus supports cross-clip note selection; velocity edit still affects foreground A only.

cases.setup_action: Select eight looped Session clips; separately select eight Arrangement MIDI tracks over clips; then attempt nine and an unlooped Session clip.
cases.expected: First two setups permitted with documented order; ninth/unlooped fallback explicitly U, never assume rejection or truncation.

cases.setup_action: With instrument/audible path, enable Preview, add note; select another MIDI track. Start playback with Follow, edit, then stop/restart.
cases.expected: Audition exists; switch shared; Follow pauses then resumes. No sample/audio or note-off timing claim.

cases.setup_action: Empty clip loop [0,4), time selection [1,3), apply Rhythm; then no time selection and apply in a reset empty clip.
cases.expected: First generated material lies in target [1,3); second targets loop [0,4). Existing-content collision cases ungraded under C1.

cases.setup_action: From pristine selected notes choose Chop and change Parts with Auto Apply on; switch Auto Apply off; change Parts; Apply.
cases.expected: Immediate first transformation; disabling restores starting notes; parameter edit alone has no effect while off; Apply transforms.

cases.setup_action: Auto Apply off, set Chop Parts 4 and apply; Undo/Redo; Reset tool.
cases.expected: Note transformation reverses/reapplies while Parts remains 4; Reset restores parameters with notes unchanged; exact default value ungraded.

cases.setup_action: Enable C-major scale and inspect Arpeggiate Distance units; select Velocity Shaper and Euclidean in a working Suite installation.
cases.expected: Distance uses scale degrees; bundled tools selectable. This is a documented-domain proposal, not target/platform availability evidence.

cases.setup_action: Same chord/rate/style, compare Gate 50, 100, 150 percent with other controls fixed.
cases.expected: Durations respectively shorter than, equal to baseline at 100, and longer than baseline. Exact sequence/style law ungraded.

cases.setup_action: With Variation 0 and no gaps/emphasis, divide one note with Parts 2, then 64 in separate reset fixtures; manually toggle gap and adjust Gaps.
cases.expected: Two then 64 divisions; manual change gives dash then is superseded by Gaps setting. Length/rounding near minimum U.

cases.setup_action: Two nonoverlapping source notes, Density 100, Spread 0, Tie 0, valid Rate.
cases.expected: Gaps filled as documented; inserted pitches have no random shift; exact note count and endpoint fitting ungraded.

cases.setup_action: Two successive different pitches, apply Start 50 percent; inspect MPE editor. Repeat with one selected note.
cases.expected: Two-note input has pitch connection whose bend begins halfway through note; one-note creation unsupported, UI response ungraded.

cases.setup_action: Target Pitch Bend with clip range ±60 semitones; inspect Amount/base ranges; set Attack 100 after positive Decay.
cases.expected: Amount allows -120..120, base -60..60; Decay resets to 0. No exact generated curve samples asserted.

cases.setup_action: One-beat grid, selected note starts at beat 2; Flam Position -100 percent then separately +100 percent.
cases.expected: Flam occupies one grid division before original for negative, beginning of original for positive; no assertion about expression carryover.

cases.setup_action: Note start 0.1 beat, end 0.8; quarter-note quantization of start only, Amount 0 percent; repeat end-only at full amount.
cases.expected: Zero amount leaves timing unchanged; end-only can change duration without moving start. Exact quantized end withheld pending tie/boundary law.

cases.setup_action: Three successive notes velocities 20,60,100; choose Velocity, Mirror only; then reset with all toggles off and rotation zero.
cases.expected: Mirror gives 100,60,20 at corresponding ordered notes; disabled permutation leaves order. Random sequences ungraded.

cases.setup_action: Starts 0,2,5 within selection [0,8), Offset/Variation 0: compare Legato, Tenuto, Staccato in reset fixtures.
cases.expected: Legato lengths 2,3,3; Tenuto original lengths; Staccato lengths 1 (half minimum start distance).

cases.setup_action: Chord pitches 60,64,67 at beat 2; grid one beat; Low=High=0, vary Tension.
cases.expected: No start-time effect when both offsets zero. Nonzero curved offset numerical law ungraded.

cases.setup_action: Selected notes within [0,4), nonconstant valid speed curve and Preserve Time Range on.
cases.expected: Result fits original selected range; exact warped starts/durations ungraded. This tool is distinct from audio Warp markers.

cases.setup_action: Select successive notes; set minimum=40, maximum=80 and apply; separately Rotate 1 with Division Grid.
cases.expected: Velocities constrained to 40..80; rotation moves envelope right one grid step; exact sample positions ungraded.

cases.setup_action: Time selection one 4/4 bar; Steps 8, Density 8, duration 1/8, Split 0, Accent Frequency 1; then duration 1/16.
cases.expected: One pattern repetition then two; every generated note accented. Edge clipping/tie identities ungraded.

cases.setup_action: Pitch min=max=60, duration min=max=1/8, velocity min=max=64; nonzero valid density, Voices 1.
cases.expected: All produced notes pitch 60, half-beat duration and velocity 64; simultaneous note count at most one. Exact total count U.

cases.setup_action: Pitch minimum=60, maximum=72, Jitter 100 percent, nonzero valid density.
cases.expected: All generated pitches remain in 60..72 despite Jitter; exact timing/count ungraded.

cases.setup_action: Active C-major clip; choose root and add second chord; select each chord and adjust one duration.
cases.expected: Root chooser restricted to scale notes; each selected chord shows its own settings. Exact chord pitches ungraded absent chord-bank contract.

cases.setup_action: One active voice pitch 60 velocity 90; other three disabled and assigned different pitches; generate with nonzero density.
cases.expected: Generated notes originate only from active pitch-60 voice, with configured velocity; exact phase/pattern/count U.

cases.setup_action: Load invalid/duplicate note IDs, nonfinite times or truncated clip XML.
cases.expected: U here; load validation belongs to MIDI note storage and Live Set structure; their finite released clauses do not establish editor recovery.

cases.setup_action: Enter nonnumeric, nonfinite or out-of-range value in each tool control; attempt unavailable choice.
cases.expected: U: no clamp/refuse/default/error-message law claimed.

cases.setup_action: Begin drag/draw/stretch, then Escape before release; change focus or close editor midgesture.
cases.expected: U: selection Escape is specified, edit-gesture rollback/commit and undo grouping are not.

cases.setup_action: Perform a continuous parameter drag in Auto Apply, switch tools, Undo once, then Redo.
cases.expected: U for transaction granularity and restored selection; only finite prior-state reversibility/parameter non-undo clauses specified.

cases.setup_action: Save edited clips/tool settings, close and reopen Set.
cases.expected: U for editor/tool-settings serialization and selection/focus restoration; note data uses canonical note-storage clauses only.

cases.setup_action: Delete active clip/track, unload instrument or Max tool, close Set during preview/apply; make AMXD missing/unreadable.
cases.expected: U for note-off, resource cleanup, partial-note mutations, recovery prompt and latency.

cases.setup_action: Apply each generator to occupied time selection with nonoverlapping and overlapping pitches/times.
cases.expected: U because introduction and detailed usage differ; no replacement semantics selected.

cases.setup_action: Press Ctrl+Shift+U (Windows)/Cmd+Shift+U (macOS) after changing quantize settings.
cases.expected: U whether opens settings or applies without opening; use explicit menu/panel for graded cases.

cases.setup_action: Apply pitch-target LFO; switch Notes/MPE views and expression lanes.
cases.expected: U for Notes-view curve visibility because section contains conflicting statements.

cases.setup_action: Edit sounding/sustained notes while transport loops or MIDI input is held; change loop/clip selection.
cases.expected: U for engine scheduling, stuck-note handling and sample timing; playback-core owner remains canonical.

cases.setup_action: Keep time selection and disjoint note selection active together; apply transform.
cases.expected: U for precedence and boundary membership; no inferred target intersection/union.

cases.setup_action: Transform notes with pitch, slide, pressure and release-velocity data, including overlap, split/join and reverse.
cases.expected: U for expression preservation/resampling except documented Join preservation and named MPE tool output.

cases.setup_action: Move or transform notes beyond minimum/maximum pitch, negative time, zero duration or across loop bounds.
cases.expected: U for clipping/refusal/deletion/wrapping; serialization domain limits are not editing rules.

cases.setup_action: Reset identical note/tool state; reapply random mode, save/reopen and repeat.
cases.expected: U for generator seed, distribution, sample count, persistence, independence and repeatability; range predicates remain only finite documented expectations.
